metadata.title: FETES DU CENTENAIRE de MARCELIN BERTHELOT

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the Didot and Bodoni styles, which were the standard for high-end French typography during this era.
